g.text: Bottom row: finished games. Tap a board: O picks the
worst result for X; X picks the best.
Buttons = the 4 upper boards; DOM order: middle row L→R, then top.
Both play perfectly from empty. Who wins?
C) Nobody, it is a draw

worst result for X; X picks the best.
Buttons = the 4 upper boards; DOM order: middle row L→R, then top.
X had two moves with a win underneath, but O's best
reply took each one away. Your top board: a draw.
The same two rules, run by computer over all 255,168
games from the empty board, give a draw too (told, a
claim). Chess has far too many games to finish this way.
